Export ImprintomeSet Outputs to Disk

Source: R/ImprintomeSet-summary-export.R
export.Rd

Writes the ImprintomeSet object, selected result tables, and optionally stored plots to outdir. Data-frame/matrix results are exported as TSV; other result objects are saved as RDS. Plot export supports ggplot-compatible, ComplexHeatmap, recorded, and file-backed plot objects as plot files when possible; other plot object types are serialized as RDS.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'ImprintomeSet'
export(
  x,
  outdir,
  result_names = NULL,
  save_plots = FALSE,
  plot_names = NULL,
  plot_device = "pdf",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  prefix = "imprintome",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An ImprintomeSet object.

outdir

Output directory.

result_names

Character vector of result names to export. NULL means all.

save_plots

Logical; whether to export plot objects in plots(x).

plot_names

Character vector of plot names to export when save_plots=TRUE. NULL means all stored plots.

plot_device

Graphics device for ggplot export ("pdf" or "png").

width

Plot width in inches. NULL uses the figure size recorded by the plot (radar plots from PlotRadar() record a square size that leaves room for their labels, about 17 in for the selected panel), otherwise plot-specific defaults (12 for radar plots, otherwise 8).

height

Plot height in inches. NULL uses the recorded figure size as for width, otherwise plot-specific defaults (12 for radar plots, otherwise 6).

overwrite

Logical; overwrite existing files.

prefix

Filename prefix for exported files, including result tables, the saved ImprintomeSet object, and plot files.

...

Reserved for future extensions.

Value

A data.frame manifest with one row per exported object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
manifest <- export(x, outdir = "imprintome_export", prefix = "imprintome", save_plots = TRUE)
head(manifest)
} # }
